entries.title: The spouse palace
entries.content: The animal under your Day Master (your day branch) is called the spouse palace. It is read as the kind of partnership you feel at home in.
entries.source: Four Pillars of Destiny - Wikipedia; Sajumuse blog
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Partner stars
entries.content: In tradition, a woman's partner star is her Officer (Power) element and a man's is his Wealth element. Years that bring that element are read as active for love.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Peach Blossom years
entries.content: When a year's animal matches your Peach Blossom star, people say you'll notice more attention and chances to meet someone.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: When the spouse palace is clashed
entries.content: If the year's animal clashes your day animal, tradition reads change in relationships: a move-in, a breakup, or a big decision.
entries.source: Sajumuse blog: Spouse Palace clashed by the year
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Gunghap (궁합)
entries.content: Korean compatibility compares two charts: elements that balance each other, animals that combine, and clashes to work around. Many couples check it before marriage.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection

entries.title: Healthy love first
entries.content: No chart decides who you should love. If a relationship feels unsafe, call the National Domestic Violence Hotline: 1-800-799-7233.
entries.label: Tradition - for reflection
